legal_entity: EMM Ventures AG, Bahnhofstrasse 11, 6300 Zug, Switzerland (Terms of Service / Membership Terms); registration number not published on the pages read.
application_conditions: No application page: the referral table is printed on the card page and the link/code is generated in the THORWallet app ('Get the app' buttons point to referral.thorwallet.org). Who may refer (any user, or cardholders only) is not stated on the pages read; no referral-specific terms document was found (the Terms of Service only state that THORWallet 'may receive … referral or affiliate remuneration' from third parties, and the fetcher summary of Section 12 says referral fees come from a Card Provider).
paid_action: Card page table: 'Per referred signup Up to $25'; 'On their card FX spend Up to 0.2%'. 'Your rewards activate when a referral funds their card and makes a first purchase - never on signup alone.'
validation_conditions: Referred user must fund the THORWallet Card and make a first purchase; the per-signup amount and the FX-spend share are stated as 'Up to', without the conditions that set the actual amount.

commission.model_note: 'Up to $25' per referred signup plus 'Up to 0.2%' of the referred user's card FX spend; both 'Paid monthly in USDC'. Duration of the FX-spend share, caps and the criteria behind 'up to' are not published.

payout.holdbacks_note: Rewards activate only after the referral funds the card and makes a first purchase.

rules_note: No referral terms, channel rules, prohibited-promotion rules or country restrictions were found on the pages read (card page, fees page, Membership Terms v1.1, Terms of Service v2 first half, help centre). The Membership Terms mention a 'valid invite code' that waives/reduces the membership fee for the referred user ($5 → free on Basic; $124 → $99 on Premium).
allowed_countries_note: Not stated. Card availability itself: 175+ countries (indicative list on the card page), 31 excluded; paid memberships not available to UK residents.

evidence.title: Crypto Mastercard with Swiss IBAN - Self-Custody | THORWallet (referral table)
evidence.excerpt: 'Your rewards activate when a referral funds their card and makes a first purchase - never on signup alone.' Table: 'Per referred signup Up to $25'; 'On their card FX spend Up to 0.2%'; 'Paid monthly in USDC.' App download buttons link to referral.thorwallet.org.

evidence.title: Membership Terms — THORWallet (Version 1.1 · November 2026)
evidence.excerpt: Basic 'Free with a valid invite code, otherwise USD 5 one-off activation'; Premium 'USD 124 one-off, or USD 99 with a valid invite code'. No referral-reward clause for the referrer.

evidence.title: Terms of Service - THORWallet (Version 2 · July 2026)
evidence.excerpt: 'We may receive fees, spreads, rebates, revenue share, referral or affiliate remuneration' (THORWallet as recipient); 'including affiliate remuneration embedded in a route'. Section 12 (card services, referral fees from a Card Provider) read only as a fetcher summary.

notes: Identified only — nobody contacted, no application. An in-app user referral scheme with a revenue-share component (up to 0.2% of referred FX spend); no publisher/affiliate programme page, no terms document and no channel rules were found, so suitability for a comparison site cannot be assessed. Needs a browser read of the app's referral screen or a direct question to THORWallet (David's decision).
